selected_evidence.requirement: Daily rotation with seven compressed archives
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the active rule, successful parser validation, exactly seven valid gzip archives, and no eighth archive.

selected_evidence.requirement: Application can continue writing after rotation
selected_evidence.summary: A held-open descriptor wrote after forced rotation; the inode remained unchanged, old content was compressed, and post-rotation content reached the active log.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 were identical before and after the work and restart.
Captures the healthy baseline and old boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered crond, persisted rule, seven valid archives, and successful post-restart application-log write.
